items.text: Samo šalimo se, da se smejemo, Nana-pesar-jan. Bi šel? Če bi šel, bi bila moja srčna želja.
items.q: Maman says they are only joking, and if her husband ever left, it would answer her prayers. Does this sound like her?

items.text: Kolikorkoli sem rekla, ne bíj otrok, je rekel: v vojni sem utrpel bojni šok, ne morem si pomagati.
items.q: Maman quotes her husband's excuse that the war left him shell-shocked. Does it sound like plain everyday speech?
before: – Samo šalimo se, da se smejemo, Nana-pesar-jan. Bi šel? Če bi šel, bi bila moja srčna želja. Za boga. Prisegam pri svojem življenju. Kar se je zgodilo s Hashemom in Abolfazlom, je bila tudi njegova krivda. Ves čas jih je tepel.

items.text: Bojím se, da bo postal kot tisti njegov prijatelj, Hamid.
items.q: Maman worries her son will end up like his poet friend Hamid. Does this line read correctly?
before: Mahboubeh se je zasmejala in Maman je rekla:

items.text: Nastal je konec sveta. Njihova Bibi je govorila: ko pride konec sveta, se zemlja ves čas trese.
items.q: Maman says it is the end of days, as the old people of Bibi's day used to say. Does this sound like her?
Maman asks her son whether he passed his doctoral defense. Does this short question sound natural?

items.text: Vse, kar delaš, so samo krpanke.
items.q: One person scoffs that everything the other does is a patch job. Does 'samo krpanke' fit?
before: – Kaj veš ti o teh rečeh? Sam vem, kaj počnem.

items.q: A girl coolly asks a boy who keeps her talking whether he has finished what he came for. Does this sound natural?
before: – Dvajset minut, ki ste rekli, da jih imate, še ni poteklo.

items.text: Kvečjemu so nadzornikom doma namesto prašnega tekstilnega tepiha dali tepih v modri barvi.
items.q: Eskandar says at best the dorm monitors got blue carpeting instead of the dust-colored kind. Is this clear and natural?
before: – Pa to je to. Doslej še nisem videl sobe s preprogo.

items.text: Napisal sem lastne teorije o kvantni fiziki, naš neumni profesor pa mi je vzel in dal petindvajset stotink.
items.q: Eskandar complains that his idiot professor gave his theories a quarter of a point. Does this sound natural?
before: Eskandar je še malo nadaljeval z vzdihovanjem in ječanjem, pa rekel:

items.text: Raje bi delil sobo z njimi kakor s kurčevcem, kot si ti.
items.q: Hooman tells a roommate he'd rather room with anyone than a dick-brain like him. Does 'kurčevcem' work as a crude insult?
before: – Prednjačenje Univerze AmirKabir v študentskih gibanjih je z ničemer primerljivo. Tudi če na Sharifu obstaja zbor tako imenovanih elit, iz katerih doslej ni prišla niti ena sama revolucionarna teorija.

items.text: Požiralec tičjih glav, zakaj kvasiš neumnosti?
items.q: Hooman hurls a crude insult at a roommate who is talking nonsense. Does 'Požiralec tičjih glav' sound like a real insult?
An older student teases a first-year casually, not as a real insult. Does 'jeben zelenec' sound like friendly crude teasing?

items.text: Glej, kakšno traparijo si zagrešil, posrani možgani.
items.q: Eskandar snaps at Amir, calling him shit-for-brains. Does 'posrani možgani' sound natural?
before: Eskandar se je obrnil k meni in glavo ter prsi pomaknil proti meni. Razširil je oči in z osornim tonom, ne da bi izgubil svoj prizvok Alaina Delona, rekel:

items.text: Možganadrek, nihče te ne bo imenoval nemega, če ne prdneš.
items.q: Eskandar wakes Amir with a crude twist on an old saying about keeping quiet. Does this sound natural?
before: …na svoji postelji in razmišljal o tem, o čemer sva govorila z Niloofar. Luči na hodniku so ugasnile in hrup iz drugih sob je tudi zaspal. V temi in tišini polnoči je Hoomanova senca vstopila skozi vrata in šla naravnost k škatli sladkic. Kakor da je vohljala. Zjutraj me je Eskandar zbudil in rekel:

items.q: Eskandar, fed up with a back-and-forth argument, snaps: fine, whatever the fuck. Does this sound natural?
before: In tako sta se prerekala sem in tja, in z vsakim prerekanjem so ponovitve dobivale na hitrosti. Dokler ni Eskandar rekel:

items.text: Danes ne razpravljajte v sobi, iz športne vzgoje sem dobil dvanajst, živci so mi v kurcu, pa vas bom opsoval.
items.q: Hooman, in a foul mood after a bad grade, warns his roommates. Does this sound like how he would say it?
